name: Proof of delivery
summary: Keeps a register of proof of delivery for every completed stop, flags stops finished without a photo or signature, and queues a re-attempt for failed stops for approval. Crons read and draft; a person approves every re-attempt.

all.evidence: 3 call transcripts describe proof of delivery by hand (WhatsApp photos, paper signings, monthly upload to Drive)

covered_by.capture-proof: platform (Onfleet driver app takes the signature, photos and notes at completion); needs-proof cron checks them
covered_by.upload-pod: pods cron (proof reads into the register)
covered_by.record-keeping: pods cron (searchable register of completed stops)
covered_by.other: pods cron register (search by address or short id instead of old archives); the customer chase is Onfleet's own completion notice

crons.name: pods
crons.summary: Completed stops since the last run go into the proof register.

crons.name: needs-proof
crons.summary: Completed stops with no photo or signature are re-read and flagged once the grace period has passed.

crons.name: reattempt
crons.summary: Failed stops queue a re-attempt task in Onfleet for approval.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations are reads only: completed tasks and single tasks, with their completion details. The register is the workflow's own store, not a platform write. Creating a task notifies the customer and changes live dispatch, so it is a live operation and waits for a person.

onfleet.covers: completed tasks and proof fields (photo ids, signature, failure reason), single task reads, re-attempt task creation for approval

gaps: locate2u and starshipit: their proof-of-delivery pages were read in the mining file, but neither is in core/sdk/platforms, so there is no adapter. Their proof steps are recorded in the mining file for the next build.

Google Workspace (the monthly upload of slip photos to Drive) and WhatsApp (drivers sending photos into a group chat) are the manual steps the calls describe. No adapter exists for them in this build, so filing stays with the admin.
Proof photos and signatures are referenced by upload ids only. No download operation for them is mapped, so the register holds the ids and the image stays in Onfleet.
Onfleet failure reasons: only NONE and UNABLE_TO_LOCATE appear in the docs read. Any other non-NONE value counts as a failure.
Onfleet customer chase: Onfleet sends its own completion notice with proof. No documented operation sends a proof or chase message, so one is not built.
Onfleet sdk.* operations are unmapped (not in the published spec), so only core.docs.* operations are used.

Onfleet get_tasks_all requires from (Unix ms): pods always sends it, the saved cursor or the lookback_days window start (1 to 365, default 30). A re-attempt needs the stop's destination id (Onfleet requires destination on a new task); a stop without one is skipped and not queued.
Every adapter is docs-only until a sandbox Onfleet account proves the fields and the re-attempt task.

evidence.calls: 3 call transcripts read in the mining file (2 mining contractors, 1 quarry sand supplier with trucking); about 100 delivery slips a month stated
evidence.platforms: Onfleet, locate2u and starshipit docs read in the mining file; only Onfleet has mapped operations in the kit
